title: cotton tea cozy
text: cotton tea cozy. I purchased three different cozies and I have to say, this one is my favorite.  It is padded and therefore a bit more insulated.  The base, which is removable for washing, is a tiny bit disappointing as it's just a thin board.  In fact, at first I was afraid it was just cardboard, but its slightly better than cardboard.  Wish it was a cork board like material - like the other two, but it's not a deal breaker.  The print is very sweet rose buds/green leaves/stems,  with a deep pink wrap edge and white background.  I like it.
